	desc = ante_persia.40.d
	picture = GFX_ante_event_war

	immediate = {
		set_country_flag = { flag = PRS_empire_broke days = 3650 value = 1 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = PRS_TT_EMPIRE_BREAKS
		hidden_effect = {
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { PRS_unrest_egypt > 69.9 } } PRS_revolt_egypt = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { PRS_unrest_babylon > 69.9 } } PRS_revolt_babylon = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { PRS_unrest_ionia > 69.9 } } PRS_revolt_ionia = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { PRS_unrest_lydia > 69.9 } } PRS_revolt_lydia = yes }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { PRS_unrest_bactria > 69.9 } } PRS_revolt_bactria = yes }
		}
		start_civil_war = {
			ideology = fascism
			size = 0.3
			states = { 359 360 361 362 363 409 410 411 412 413 414 415 418 419 }
			states_filter = { is_owned_by = ROOT }
			set_cosmetic_tag = PRS_PRETENDER
		}
		log = "ANTE|[GetDateText]|empire_breaks|PRS|PRS"
		set_variable = { PRS_unrest_egypt = 20 }
		set_variable = { PRS_unrest_babylon = 20 }
		set_variable = { PRS_unrest_ionia = 20 }
		set_variable = { PRS_unrest_lydia = 20 }
		set_variable = { PRS_unrest_bactria = 20 }
		PRS_unrest_update = yes
	}
	option = {
		name = ante_persia.40.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 100 }
		add_war_support = 0.10
		add_manpower = 5000
	}
